chapter_seo_title: Cavalry — Dao-Twisted World Chapter 115 Analysis | The Advent of War in Siqi
chapter_meta_description: Lü Zhuangyuan’s troupe runs into an army commandeering silver from a band of grotesque nuns. Power shifts, borders fracture, and our heroes realize Siqi is on the brink of war.
og_title: Cavalry — A Promissory Note Written in Iron
og_description: The slow burn of folk horror meets the sudden thunder of cavalry. Anci Nunnery’s nuns trade silver for a sword, and Lü Zhuangyuan begins to realize the whole region is about to burn.
twitter_title: The Dao-Twisted World just introduced cavalry. It’s not a power-up—it’s a warning.
twitter_description: You Zixiong’s Dark Peak Riders don’t care about curses or gods. They have a war to fight and a schedule to keep. Siqi is fracturing, and our ragtag survivors are stuck in the middle.
